_about: Curated, reviewable metadata about what each PSI experiment table represents. Every entry states its basis (the PSI text or table feature it was read from). Values here never change source data; they describe granularity, study type and documented table notes. Edited by hand; validated by tests.

_granularity.per_test: Each row is one test (ignition / burn).
_granularity.per_test_setpoint: Each row is one set point within a test; several rows can share one ignition.
_granularity.per_specimen: Each row is one specimen burned in a single test.
_granularity.test_log: Each row is one test but the table states only identifiers and material.
_granularity.test_day_summary: Each row summarizes a test day (several tests); listed values are not per test.
_granularity.test_matrix: Each row states campaign ranges / lists for a fuel; which combinations were tested is not stated.
_granularity.session_log: Each row is an instrument session; no combustion conditions.
_granularity.publication_figure_index: Each row points to a figure in a publication; not an experimental observation.
_granularity.no_table: PSI publishes no experiment table for this investigation.

PSI-10.basis: columns Day/Test give one test id per row (e.g. 19115A1)

PSI-20.basis: row = Year/Month/Date; 'Flames Ignited is the number ignited on that day'; notes: 'chamber pressures were also varied but are not identified in this summary table'
dataset_notes: Oxygen concentrations are approximate values for tests that ignited on that day (table note).
Chamber pressure is explicitly not identified in this table.

PSI-21.basis: row = Test Day (YYDDD) with 'Flames ignited' count

PSI-22.basis: row = Test Day (YYDDD); continuation rows list further fuel concentrations

PSI-23.basis: row = Test Day (YYDDD) with 'Flames Ignited' count
dataset_notes: Table note: 'Atmosphere is ~1 atm but pressure increases and O2% drops with vitiation.' Pressure is not given per row.

PSI-26.basis: row = test number with sample material only

PSI-47.basis: objective: 'mitigate the risk for the Smoke Aerosol Measurement Experiment (SAME)'; rows are sessions D1, D2

PSI-60.basis: approach: 'combine image processing, experimental diagnostics, and detailed soot modeling' of SPICE data

PSI-62.basis: approach: 'high-resolution computational modeling with experimental validation'

PSI-68.basis: one row per fuel with lists ('0.17; 0.21;0.25; 0.3') and ranges ('0.1 - 5')
dataset_notes: Oxygen and pressure are lists of campaign values; the tested oxygen-pressure combinations are not stated, so no (O2, P) points are formed.

PSI-98.basis: one Sample Number per row (S1, S2)

Percent O2 (Note 1).note: Table Note 1: 'Derived from measured CO2 product' — oxygen is derived by the investigators, not directly measured.

dataset_notes: Rows beginning 'Note' and 'F1C1/F1C2' are annotations, not specimens.

PSI-106.basis: row = Test Date with fuel used that day

PSI-107.basis: rows share GMT ignition times with different fuel rates (several set points per flame)

PSI-115.basis: approach: 'Direct numerical simulation via a Navier-Stokes nodal approach'

PSI-117.basis: approach: 'OpenFOAM was used to develop a 3-D CFD model' validated against FLEX measurements

PSI-142.basis: columns 'Reference Publication Link', 'Figure ID in Reference'; approach: 'three different numerical modeling schemes'

PSI-47.relation: PSI lists PSI-102 (SAME) as related; DAFT was a feasibility test for SAME instrumentation. Not merged: DAFT is a different investigation.

PSI-117.relation: PSI lists FLEX (PSI-69) as related; PSI-117 is a ground CFD study using FLEX data. Not merged: modeling study, not the flight experiment.

PSI-62.relation: Modeling study validated against BASS data (PSI-25, PSI-26).

PSI-142.relation: Simulations and ground experiments using FLEX conditions.
